column1: # source-fetches.tsv — declared fetch provenance, one capture row per registry id (round 23; S001-S016 added round 24)
# D7 (round 23): bind every mined row WITHOUT an in-row pin to a declared representation; round 24 (routed D5)
# adds same-day captures for the sixteen historical in-row-pinned rows, classified in corpus/inrow-pins.tsv.
# 16 tab-separated columns, no tabs inside a cell:
#   status             registry status at capture time (must match the row)
#                      provenance row to another id/status/URL changes it
#   url                exact registered URL string from the row's source cell
#   fetched            ISO date the bytes were fetched (2026-10-21)
#   representation     decoded-http-body-v1: Content-Encoding removed by curl;
#                      digest and byte count are of that decoded body.
#                      decoded-http-body-volatile-v1: same digest domain, but the
#                      raw HTML is deployment/response-coupled (daily chrome or a
#                      per-response token); the normalized digest is a more stable
#                      point attestation, still chrome-sensitive, never a drift
#                      pin. No cross-capture equality is enforced.
#   sha256             sha256 of the representation bytes
#   bytes              byte count of the representation
#   revision           40-hex immutable revision for a moving-ref URL, else -
#   quote              declared quote, shape-checked only by the census: <=25 ASCII words.
#                      Round-24 rows were located at capture time with
#                      (count >= 1; raw-literal-v1 rows by a byte search of the body)
#   normalization      rendered-text-v1: declared ONCE in corpus/rendered-text-v1.py
#                      (round 24, routed D6; it reproduces all ten round-23 normalized
#                      digests); raw-literal-v1: the decoded body bytes, no transform
#   normalized_sha256  sha256 of the normalized text (rendered-text-v1 only), else -
#   location           section/heading the quote was located under
# A digest here is a point attestation of the declared representation on the
# fetched date, never a content-drift pin and never a deployed-product proof.
# Legacy in-row `Fetch sha256:` values (S001-S016) are historical point
# observations with undocumented representation. Since round 24 each is
# classified against its same-day capture row in corpus/inrow-pins.tsv
# census recomputes from the digests here; the historical pin itself is kept.
